No Conference record easily matches this exact pairing.

The quote itself uses characteristic McConkie theological language ('schoolmaster,' 'higher law,' 'lower law,' 'carnal commandments') which increases risk—it's polished enough to sound plausible but could be synthesized from his known writings rather than from this specific talk.

Cross-reference Alma 12:9-10 connection is speculative. While both involve God's word, the parallel drawn ('internalization of covenant') requires significant inferential leaps and doesn't represent an explicit doctrinal link in the source material.
